assistedInstructions: Stealth Attack (cost 1d6): you must have the Hide action's Invisible condition. Invisibility from a spell or another source alone is not enough.
This attack doesn't end that Hide condition if you end this turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover. Confirm the cover at turn end with the DM; no turn or cover tracking is automatic.
This does not grant Invisible or prevent other causes of Hide ending. If the cover requirement fails, end Hide's Invisible condition manually. Do not remove unrelated Invisible effects.

notes: Targets, turn state, and applied conditions remain assisted.

nodes.text: You gain the following Cunning Strike option. Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6). If you have the Hide action’s Invisible condition, this attack doesn’t end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.
